`README.md`:

```md
# TShock AntiCheat

面向 Terraria **1.4.5.8** 的 TShock 服务端反作弊插件源码。

**项目状态：`paused_by_user`。** 这里公开的是开发源码，不是可直接部署的发行版。默认模式为 `ObserveOnly`；历史测试结果不能自动证明新构建可用于生产服。当前范围见 [M18 后总范围](anticheat-scope-handoff/AntiCheat-M18-PostScope-Master.md)，原任务的活动字段见 [台账](docs/m3-target-ledger.json)。

当前保留的有限任务包括普通 Butcher 高低伤、地图刷子、部分越权消息、9999 拿取与掉落物、简单锁血和少数召唤及物品规则。Windows/OS 防火墙、REST、旧版本兼容和 PvP 专项已退出当前范围；完整伤害、物品来源、液体电路与回滚模型等已冻结。源码中仍有旧阶段实现，不能把它们视为当前开发目标或生产资格。

## 构建

需要可构建 `net9.0` 的 .NET SDK，以及自行取得并审计过的 Terraria 1.4.5.8 对应 TShock/TSAPI/OTAPI 运行包。本仓库不分发这些程序集。运行包目录须包含 `ServerPlugins/TShockAPI.dll`、`bin/TerrariaServer.dll` 和 `bin/OTAPI.dll`。

```powershell
dotnet build src/AntiCheat.Plugin.TShock/AntiCheat.Plugin.TShock.csproj -c Release -p:TShockBaselineRoot="C:\path\to\audited-server"
```

独立 Core 测试可从 `tests/AntiCheat.Core.Tests` 运行。完整适配器测试还需要匹配的外部 TShock 源码补丁和隔离运行环境；本次开源整理未运行构建或测试。构建前应核对实际加载的运行时版本和程序集哈希。

本仓库只收录源码、测试、必要数据和少量范围记录。本地实验世界、数据库、日志、构建产物、原始证据及第三方工具副本均保留在本机，不属于公开源码。

## 许可

项目自有代码按 [GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE) 发布。改编数据与测试夹具涉及的第三方许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

```

`anticheat-scope-handoff/AntiCheat-M18-PostScope-Master.md`:

```md
# AntiCheat M18后：总范围重置与有限持续开发指令

版本：`M18-SCOPE-RESET-20260915-v1`。
用途：交给没有本次聊天上下文的本地Codex，替代旧开发目标，而非只追加TerraAngel专项。
状态：**交接文件已生成；项目仍按用户要求暂停。只有用户明确选择“继续开发”或设置本文件的新Goal后，才恢复实现、构建和实验。**

## 0. 首读摘要：必须贯穿整个会话

本服需要高性价比、能阻止实际破坏的反作弊，不再追原72项完成率。已确定作弊首次写前阻断并永久封责任账号；明确禁止的无敌帧玩法按服规踢出；证据不足的异常静默记录，不能把所有新功能都降成只记录。

**删除**Windows/OS防火墙联动、REST全部专项、旧版本兼容、全部PvP专项。**冻结**全伤害/全受伤模型、通用射速/移动硬判、全物品来源、通用合成不耗资源、无限魔力、概率作弊推断、实验液体/全电路模拟、全因果恢复，以及History/回滚插件集成。完整GUI大验收仅在用户主动要求后做；世界与数据库备份协调不进入近期开发。

**当前主线**：TerraAngel普通屠杀（高伤和低伤密集请求）、地图刷子（图格/墙/液体破坏/放置/替换及绕过）、告示牌/闪电/9999拿取与掉落物具体入口核查；简单锁血和拒绝受伤/永久闪避、召唤/哨兵宽松最大容量、少数重要物品数量和超前物品。高频屠杀和地图刷子已经被用户重新提到高优先级，不得套用更早的冻结意见。

保留M18已交付28条精确条件资格和既有BLOCK、SSC、Bouncer、权限、身份/代际、证据和封禁持久化。不通过删保护省预算，不为凑资格数量重复开发。下面的有限任务是完整当前队列；没有列为活跃的旧待办，不自动恢复。

## 1. 本文件如何生效，如何处理冲突

### 1.1 依据与事实层级

- **用户决策**：本文件中的删除、冻结、处罚偏好、业务优先级和验收时机，来自M18收尾后的连续讨论；后说的明确修正优先于先前建议。
- **实施安排**：下文任务分组、短队列与范围迁移步骤，是把这些决策变成可执行工作的方法，不冒充已经实现的产品能力。
- **技术事实**：以本地实际源码、锁定运行时、加载的DLL与对应证据为准。用户经验是有价值的复现线索，旧源码核查是入口线索，二者不自动成为当前版本Production资格。
- 本文件由用户交给项目后，是新的**项目任务范围要求**，不是越过系统/开发者指令、工具审批或安全边界的授权。对项目内可编辑的旧范围条款做准确迁移；不能借“覆盖旧目标”修改全局权限或绕过拒绝。

### 1.2 以下旧目标和旧结论不再驱动开发

1. `Codex-M16-Plus-Major-Coverage-Goal.md`的“R0至少三分之二”“48/72”“保持困难任务无限推进直至比例达标”失效。历史目标保持原样可追溯，当前Goal不得恢复它。
2. 原72项的原文、编号、原验收和历史完成状态保留，但它们不再是必须全部补齐的活动队列。取消、冻结、只维护都不算原验收完成。
3. 旧《现状与72项裁剪建议》《Capability-Review-and-Scope-Proposal》《范围重定稿与72项映射》只供历史参考。尤其“锁血整体冻结”“高频伤害一律不做”“先集成History”“GUI/备份先收尾”等旧安排已经被后续用户修正。
4. 旧《TerraAngel专项防御核查与下一轮范围》降为技术参考；它不足以独立描述所有共识。**9999拿取与掉落物核查是随后追加，必须纳入。**
5. 旧“QTR专项整体结束”仍禁止重跑M15已经结束的燃烧专项、历史崩溃与被拒绝刺激；不禁止用户后来明确要求的锁血/永久闪避定向研究。不要把新研究扩成整个QTR工具大全。

### 1.3 先迁移项目入口，不能只在聊天中说已理解

一次性检查实际适用的`AGENTS.md`/`AGENTS.override.md`、当前Goal、短恢复文件、当前manifest和原台账的**活动字段**。上传台账示例中仍有`checkpoint`的48项目标、`m16Checkpoint.goalFile`和`requiredCompletedCount=48`；恢复文件也可能继续指回旧目标。必须使其活动导航一致指向本文件。

操作要求：
- 将本文件保存为仓库中的单一当前范围入口；根/相关目录AGENTS只合并简短摘要和路径，不全文复制长报告，不覆盖无关开发规范。
- 旧Goal/旧待办改为`superseded`等项目现有等价状态；暂停的旧Goal不能被原样resume。历史快照、M15—M18发行包、失败记录不可重写。
- 在现有台账中增加或更新独立的“当前范围/活动子范围/删除冻结原因”字段，或复用项目已有等价机制。不要改变原`id/name/originalAcceptance`，不要另建72个新任务或另一套资格库。
- 同步当前恢复入口及所有新子代理的任务约束。禁止主代理改了方向，子代理仍沿旧REST/GUI/全来源待办继续工作。
- 不直接编辑客户端内部Goal数据库冒充已切换；缺少会话控制能力时清楚告知用户应替换Goal，仓库文件先保持暂停。
- 仅范围迁移时不启动游戏、不编译、不运行专项、不下载参考项目、不重打包。

附带`AntiCheat-M18-Scope72-Map.md`是原ID映射草表，用于这一次迁移；任务状态仍由本地现有台账统一维护。之后仅按当前任务读取相应行，不反复把约3MB历史JSON全文塞进上下文。

## 2. 已交付基线与不可误写的能力

交接依据为M18阶段总报告及BUILD-INFO：Terraria 1.4.5.8 / protocol326；默认ObserveOnly，未部署生产。M18插件SHA256：
`B7D9990BF7FA25A51689D3D85D1A498C4CE464E6B13F78B7BD164299A70A4BDF`。

M18保留28条精确条件资格，M16—M18新增永封资格为0；原合同整项交付9项：C05、E01、I02、J01、J02、J03、J04、K03、K04。此数字不是防护率，也不是要求接下来补满的分母。若本地已有后续改动，先保留并核对，不能强行回退到M18。

必须保留这些区别：
- 月总核心免疫阶段BLOCK不等于普通秒杀已防住。
- 最大生命/魔力结构检查不等于锁血/无限魔力检测。
- 箱子容量权限、箱子短序列修复不等于所有物品生成与掉落物已防住。
- 旧M4/旧用户实验不转授新候选资格；独立草稿通过不等于进入M18。
- 窄规则条件不满足时，不声称其已生效。默认ObserveOnly不自动改成正式服Production。

已有`NPC01.ServerDebuffDamage/1.0.0`、`CONTAINER01.ChestResizeAuthority/1.0.0`及暗影焰规则优先作为维护对照。旧专项核查指出TerraAngel绕过屠杀与异常扩箱有对应路径，但不得因此写“TerraAngel全部防住”。

## 3. 删除、冻结、按需验收、维护：四种不同处置

### 3.1 明确删除：从当前及未来默认目标移除

| 删除范围 | 活动开发/交付应删除什么 | 必须留下什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows/OS防火墙联动 | 执行器、主机黑名单、部署测试与待办；后续包不再以其交付为前置 | 游戏进程内连接限制、可信socket来源、账号处罚 |
| REST | REST请求/慢HTTP/账号接口专项及相应未集成草稿 | 游戏内登录、聊天、账号命令和共用输入安全 |
| 旧版本兼容 | 旧客户端/协议/程序集适配与测试矩阵 | 当前锁定版本检查、安全解析；版本不匹配不能硬判 |
| 权威PvP和其他PvP专项 | PvP伤害/命中/射速/公平性模型与专项验收 | 防冒用身份、越权伤害目标等共享协议安全；不破坏合法协议分支 |

“删除”不是改名待办。下次有产品开发授权时，对独立模块做小范围退出构建/发布的清理；若代码与共用核心耦合，先断开专用入口与交付要求并准确记录残留，不能开展庞大重构。旧发行包/历史证据不删，不连带拆掉已工作的共享保护。仅文档迁移模式不做这些产品改动。

### 3.2 冻结：没有用户新授权，不领取，不拿它们作活跃任务前置

| 冻结内容 | 保留的有限例外 |
|---|---|
| 全武器、全Buff、全派生攻击的精确伤害重建 | 阶段宽松高伤线与TerraAngel屠杀专项活跃 |
| 完整PvE射速/通用多段命中模型 | TerraAngel低伤密集屠杀已明确重新激活；现有资源保护保留 |
| 全权威受伤、碰撞、治疗、免疫模拟 | 简单锁血、AntiHurt/永久闪避与无敌帧服规活跃，不能整体冻结 |
| 全物品可达性、全链路来源、全资产账本、永久升级消耗证明 | 少量重要物品/超前物品、实际不可能值、具体复制短序列 |
| 全装备组合和全部生效效果穷举 | 已有保护、极端数值、召唤/哨兵保守全局容量 |
| 通用合成不耗资源、概率钓鱼、资源节省、增加爆率推断 | 已有明确合成漏洞修复保留；正常机制不能被粗暴禁用 |
| 无限魔力专项 | 现有最大魔力结构规则维护；不得因现有草稿而自动续做 |
| 通用飞行/穿墙/任意地图瞬移/移动硬判 | 已有精确传送边界规则维护；屠杀/刷子中的位置伪造可作该专项必要输入 |
| 全图爆炸因果、全液体传播调度、全电路/实体生成模拟 | 刷子直接写入/实际工作量预算、现有权限与有限资源保护 |
| 自研通用回滚、追赃、全掉落退款 | 现有可归因的小范围恢复维护，不建设全经济恢复 |
| History/WorldEdit等历史回滚工具的搜集、移植、集成 | 用户当前优先用既有世界及数据库定时备份；不是先找轮子再开发 |
| 更多原生已忽略的公告、NPC/Buff全集、修改器功能大全 | 维护已审规则；仅本文件指明的真实破坏分支补缺 |

“高优先级冻结”仅表示重要但超出当前有限实现范围，不是允许代理自行解冻。反过来，不得以“完整模型冻结”为借口拒绝活跃的简单锁血、极端伤害或屠杀专项。发现活跃切片实际要求跨入冻结大工程时，记录具体缺口、保存局部成果，换其他活跃切片；不得暗中扩大预算，也不得宣布整个业务永久不做。

### 3.3 用户主动要求后才做

完整stock GUI大验收及商店/重铸/整理/快存/储物/合成/钓鱼全流程矩阵，不作为本轮前置、检查点或结束条件。世界+数据库备份协调、恢复演练、原子备份系统也不进入近期开发。

这不等于允许破坏正常玩法：新代码只验证最接近的必要合法反例和无辜玩家情形。没有新增GUI操作步骤、不要求玩家命令购物、不强制生产客户端改造。展示框消费未恢复等历史缺陷保留记录；修改其直接相关路径时定向处理，不先做全面验收。虚空袋快存草稿没有自动优先收尾权。

### 3.4 只维护，不继续造平台

既有SSC、Bouncer、图格权限、连接预算、代际隔离、证据/制裁幂等、封禁持久化、规则健康和发布器继续维护。原B/J/K公共合同不为打勾单独审计一轮。房屋插件预计由用户另选，AntiCheat不重建房屋系统；实际插件可用且影响当前规则时做必要适配，不把任意房屋插件兼容作为前置。

## 4. 当前有限活跃队列

以下编号仅是本轮工作切片，不替代原72项ID。先做P0，P1可在P0外部等待时并行推进。P0中入口核查可短并行；不得所有代理长期写审计而不落实阻断。具体排序是实施安排，不是新添比例指标。

### P0-A 普通屠杀与阶段高伤（F04/F05/F06局部、B02/B03/I03）

用户要求：普通秒杀及TerraAngel低伤高频Butcher不能再靠“可能先被别的规则封”来忽略。

- 使用世界进度的少量宽松档位，不要求知道本次攻击的全部来源或重建装备公式。设置独立的**记录线**与**极端阻断/封禁线**。用户举例初始阶段9999应立即处理，但9999不是已核准的原生极值；先确认所读字段、适用进度及已知必要例外，不能直接硬编码为所有场景的作弊数值。
- 超记录线保留游戏轮次/阶段最高值、少量高位样本、责任会话、NPC类型/代际、请求值/实际处理结果、可用的装备/Buff和短窗上下文。记录有界、异步，不逐包同步刷库；合法/未审/已判作弊分开，不用作弊观测值自动提高阈值。
- 明确极端值应在扣血、命中归属、掉落与广播前拒绝，复用首次制裁。不能只封禁而放过正在执行的伤害。
- 对普通Butcher低伤密集请求做有限短窗口保护；至少考虑单账号/会话—NPC代际，以及跨NPC扫射的汇总维度。达到保护条件及时取消后续写入，不等整批处理完。预算止损与足够证据的永封区分，但必须认真争取可封禁的确定短序列，不得满足于全程只记录。
- 旧源码核查提示存在围绕目标位置的控制同步与重复普通伤害请求。读取真实实现和目标接收路径，不能只靠刚收到的玩家位置认定距离合法，也不能把一次位置跳变、常见包号或网络积压一律永封。
- 用最接近的正常多段/并发攻击和短暂网络恢复作定向对照，不穷举全游戏。伤害恰好等于NPC血量或致死后的血量差，不作独立作弊证明。

### P0-B 地图刷子直接破坏（H01/H02/H05局部、A01/A02/I03）

用户因TerraAngel范围刷子重新提高优先级：图格/墙/液体的破坏、放置、替换与“尝试绕过TShock”都必须核查。危害重大，即使不常用也优先。

- 首先读取刷子完整编辑/发送链，分清每种操作、范围更新、Bypass开关和实际消息入口。截图中的“无视建造范围”提示不代表刷子Bypass实现。不得沿用“还没读到”的旧结论直接结束，也不得编造机制。
- 复用TShock/已适配房屋与区域权限，对真实直接写入的完整作用范围作写前权限、坐标、类型/样式与身份校验；不能只检查请求锚点。
- 计入放置/摧毁/替换、墙、液体及批量同步的实际或可确定工作量，不能只限制摧毁土块，也不能一个覆盖很多格的请求只计一次廉价操作。
- 追踪具体绕过如何污染距离、工具、状态或权限前提。确定违规首证应拒绝当前动作、封禁责任账号，并阻止同批后续写入。单纯预算超额先止损，不把矩形施工或所有密集合法操作一律永封。
- 天然传播/环境变化不能归罪最近玩家。本任务不写传播调度器、不做全因果恢复、不集成History。备份不能代替本任务的必要预防。

### P0-C 告示牌、闪电与既有153/155核查（A01/F01/F02/F05/C05/I04局部）

- 告示牌：核对目标版本的帧内长度、字符串分配/解码、写入与广播入口；旧作者“已修复”说明不是本地验收。已有正确拒绝就复用并补对应回归，不重写第二套网络框架。区分未组装完整TCP流与完整帧中的非法长度，测试使用离线/有界隔离样本，不靠真实洪泛。
- 闪电：先找到真实按钮和调用链。确认是射弹、服务器角色特效、其他网络行为还是纯本地视觉；只有确认路径后才能定义规则，不凭与QTR彩虹文字相似就填射弹ID。纯本地效果明确列为无需服务端防护。
- 153/155：核对已有NPCDebuffDamage和扩箱条件规则在实际运行时/模式是否可用，必要时做受影响维护。已有保护不是新增成果。**消息153与Buff153不是同一概念。**

### P0-D 9999拿取与“掉落物”入口核查（C01/C02/C06/E06、A02）

这是用户最新追加的尚未回答清楚的问题，不能遗漏：TerraAngel拿取物品默认显示9999，且可选择“掉落物”路径，M18是否会直接封禁？

第一项交付先回答当前状态，再补明确缺口：读取该工具真实拿取/掉落代码，以及当前库存同步、世界掉落物生成/更新、拾取回流、SSC和Bouncer路径。对两条工具路径分别给出：当前是放行、截断/修正、仅BLOCK、还是已有足够证据永封；列实际规则/入口/条件/证据。

- 不预设9999对所有物品都越界；以目标版本该物品的真实`maxStack`、容器/消息语义及必要授权例外核对，不以数字相等直接封所有物品。
- 展示数量可能在发送前被拆分或限制，库存包有过滤也不等于世界掉落物入口同样有保护。不得只看UI或一个reader就写“两条路径已全部封禁”。
- 确实不可能的数量/类型组合且可归因到主动伪造者时，目标是写前拒绝并首次永久封责任账号；仅核心截断/拒绝不是已有永封证明。
- 正常路人拾取别人扔出的异常物品不能被连坐；不能把“当前持有者/自动拾取后发库存同步的人”当制造者。必要反例必须包含攻击账号与接收账号分离。
- 合法数值范围内凭空出现满堆不按此规则硬判，交P1-C有限监测；不扩全来源核账。

### P1-A 简单锁血、拒绝受伤/永久闪避与服规（G02/G06，B02/B03）

用户曾实际编写插件：隔离场景召唤静止怪物，观察玩家连续受伤声明而生命同步不变，捕获特征并检测。应优先复现这一有限路线，不能当成未经实验的泛泛猜想，也不能要求先建完整治疗/受伤模型。

- 模块1：仍发送受伤声明、后续有效生命长期不相应变化。核对当前版本消息顺序/会话/状态关系，只补实际涉及的合法恢复/免疫反例，争取独立硬规则。旧M4样本和用户旧实现是入口，不直接继承资格。
- 模块2：TerraAngel AntiHurt和QTR永久闪避可能提前拒绝受伤，不能假定都有模块1消息。读取各自源码/实际可见消息，设计一个最小区分实验；源于本地内部状态的诊断只能用于实验，生产判定必须使用生产可获得输入。
- 用户认为作弊者通常不避怪：用这一经验选择容易触发的被动检测场景，不为了覆盖假想最隐蔽实现而无限扩张。不得在正式服主动造伤试探玩家。
- 玩家承受持续1点伤害维持无敌帧：用户明确视为违反本服流程，不称外挂；达到明确持续行为条件直接踢出，不累计警告，不记永久作弊。不能把偶发1点伤害当成命中。
- 完全不报告受伤：无消息自身不是定罪条件；正常活跃战斗中的持续异常符合已声明服规时可踢出，明确作弊才封禁。同步停顿/手机后台/重连恢复窗口不累计为锁血证据，沿用失效连接超时，不增加移动端完整适配工程。
- 对NPC反复发1点伤害的Butcher与玩家承受1点伤害维持无敌帧是两个不同规则，处罚不能混用。

### P1-B 召唤/哨兵宽松容量上限（F03）

用户曾采用Wiki最大召唤容量作上限，超出直接封禁；希望保留这种低成本极端检查，不重建每套装备上下文。

读取当前版本可核对的Wiki和原生容量语义，用足够宽松的合法全局上界；区分召唤实体、槽位成本、攻击子射弹、哨兵及替换/退休的短暂状态。本服已知插件增益纳入支持前提，不穷举所有插件和装备。数字未核准不能猜；核准后，完整前提下确实超出可达上界的主动违规应争取首次封禁，不默认降为永久观察。

### P1-C 少数重要物品与超前物品（C02/C06/E01/E02/E03/E06局部）

用户重点是宝藏袋等少数重要物品的异常增长、明显超前物品主动使用或分发。只用小清单和有界上下文，不监控全资产历史。

单槽1→满堆可能是整理；按已观察范围内总量与短窗口合并判断更适合作为记录线。近期Boss事件、拾取、箱子、初始同步或奖励上下文可用则记录，未知就标未知。满堆/未观察到Boss击杀不自动证明制造者作弊。

服务端真实进度与本服明确规则分开；只保留用户实际采用的少量规则。明确违规的主动生成/使用/分发可按既有机制封禁；被动得到超前物品不视为制造者。已有具体复制/合成短序列补丁继续维护，通用来源与合成不耗资源模型不恢复。

## 5. 处罚合同：不全变观察，也不全变永封

| 输出 | 适用条件 | 实际行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 作弊/明确进度违规永封 | 已鉴权责任账号、适用规则与必要前提完整；经目标版本有限对照验证 | 当前有害动作写前拒绝、同步撤权、幂等持久封禁并断开；不等多次警告或人工批准 |
| 服规踢出 | 用户明确禁止的持续无敌帧/异常战斗利用达到明确条件，尚不声称确定修改器 | 终止当次会话，记录独立服规原因；不升级为永久作弊、不连坐IP |
| 安全/权限/成本BLOCK | 有独立安全策略足以拒绝，但不足以认定作弊 | 立即阻止该危险动作/后续超额工作，不把普通无权限误操作全部永封 |
| 静默记录 | 偏高伤、少数物品增长等有价值但证据不足的异常 | 有界留档，后续人工/离线AI审核；不实时依赖大模型、不悄悄扣物或封号 |

首次“完整证明”可以来自一个已闭合的短序列，不等于必须从单个包定罪；不得靠累计不确定警告替代缺失证据。资料不足只能限制该判定，不任意关闭正常玩法。核心已经Handled时不恢复有害动作，能否依据前置证据独立封禁沿既有合同处理。

## 6. 实施方法、测试边界与Token控制

使用现有Core、规则注册/准入、NetworkLab、打包器及**独立通用Terraria MCP**。开发副本允许按已有授权读取内部状态、插桩、准备世界/角色并调用原生方法；优先结构化操作和事件等待，截图只在确需视觉证据时使用。

MCP缺能力只补一个必要的通用接口，然后回业务；不嵌入AntiCheat专项平台、不要求正式客户端安装扫描器。直接设置测试状态只证明准备成功，不能代替真实请求通过/拒绝或直接调用Ban当成规则成功。

仅自有隔离环境测试；实例/端口/世界/数据库/输出目录隔离。不部署生产、不动私人原始存档、不强杀用户进程，不重试被明确拒绝的历史刺激或换层执行同一动作。普通源码分析与有界防御验证可继续，个别外部阻塞不阻塞无依赖任务。

每个切片最低验收：真实接入点、最接近合法反例、目标违规分支、写前副作用边界、正确责任账号与无辜对象不连坐。硬封复用既有资格与持久化验收能力；只对受影响范围验证，最终候选证据绑定实际加载的DLL。无需每个小改动全套重演28条，也不能把旧DLL的全绿原样署到新候选。

明确区分单测、原生调用、合成TCP、插桩客户端、现成修改器实测、未修改stock GUI。合法对照是必要定向测试，不是恢复被延后的GUI大验收。不能通过放宽断言、强设Trusted/Complete、关闭Bouncer或手改资格实现“全绿”。

费用控制：
- 只读当前范围摘要、当前切片源码与最近证据；历史按关键词和程序投影取片段，不重述M1—M18。
- 优先1条主实现线，确有独立工作时少量并行；不给每个代理完整历史，不让多个代理争用GUI/实例/同一核心文件。
- 只为会改变下一步决策的实验花成本。保存失败与新假设；没有新输入/假设就不重复运行到偶然通过。
- 合并候选后集中受影响回归与打包，文档变化不重建DLL、不伪造新里程碑。无需每个小切片都另造长报告。
- 不引入NoCheat、全量账本、运行时AI判罚或新生产基础设施；复用现成代码先看实际接口/许可/版本，只复用与本轮有关的模块，不借找轮子恢复已冻结History线。

## 7. 恢复后的执行循环与停止条件

恢复授权生效后：一次范围迁移 → 核对当前候选与P0入口 → 最小实现 → 定向验证/反例修正 → 合并并更新短状态 → 下一活跃切片。不要因为写完计划、通过一个测试、增加一条规则或完成阶段包就要求用户再次发下一轮。

但这不是无限预算目标：
- 队列仅限第4节。新发现只记“范围外发现”，除直接阻塞当前切片的最小修复外，不自动扩成新工程。
- 高优先级切片困难时必须先调查具体入口/可见输入并尝试有区分力的最小步骤，不能一开始全部标“复杂，冻结”。出现已证实的缺口、无新假设或必需外部条件时保存状态，继续其他活跃切片。
- 全部目标按各自声明范围真实交付并有证据，才称本轮目标完成。只记录、仅BLOCK、已存在、纯本地无需防护、待验证必须各自报告，不冒充全部永封。
- 仍有未达目标且资源/权限/环境限制或已无范围内有效下一步时，交付已有成果并标“暂停/部分交付”，列最小下一步与所需决策；不虚构完成，不自行解冻大模型续命。
- 用户暂停立即停止开发并安全收尾；不提高付费预算、不承诺退出或额度耗尽后继续运行。

最终只需一份实际能力表和可运行开发包（有产品变化时）：工具分支/普通行为、原ID、当前动作、具体前提、真实证据/候选身份、仍漏什么。必须单列普通Butcher高低伤、绕过153、刷子各入口、告示牌、箱子155、闪电、9999拿取、掉落物、简单锁血、拒绝受伤、无敌帧服规、召唤、重要物品。

## 8. 旧草稿如何处理，避免一恢复就续错任务

| M18停止时草稿 | 本轮安排 |
|---|---|
| REST请求行/头/body、慢HTTP生命周期 | 删除活动任务，保留历史；不集成 |
| Buff2再生守卫、旧治疗生产者模型 | 不因已有测试自动续做；只有当前锁血切片明确需要且低成本时复用局部，不恢复无限魔力 |
| 虚空袋附近快存85链 | 暂不单独收尾；与P0-D/P1-C具体路径有关才读取必要部分 |
| 文本/标签/日志 | 游戏内部分仅当前告示牌/消息路径实际涉及才补；不扩大到REST |
| B01—B04、B05/A03形式验收 | 不为增加原ID完成数继续；当前规则真实缺陷才定点修 |
| 展示框消费未恢复 | 保留真实缺陷记录；相关代码改动时定向复验，不作为全GUI大验收前置 |

## 9. 范围迁移结束时的短检查

本节只要求一次简短回执，不是新的审计项目。写清：当前范围文件位置；旧48/72目标不再活动；四类删除；冻结清单与Butcher/刷子/锁血例外；GUI/备份不在近期；9999与掉落物已入队；历史资格/原验收未改；当前保持暂停还是已获恢复授权；下一具体任务。

若文件只被放在目录里、AGENTS/Goal/恢复入口仍指向旧范围，就不能声称完成了范围迁移。

**全局适用的删除：**旧版本兼容不是某一个原ID，适用于整个旧版本构建/测试范围；PvP也是跨F06/G03等子范围删除。不能为了保留混合原ID而恢复删除子项。

**历史不等于待办：**原字段`originalAcceptance`用于说明历史合同，并非本轮全部验收义务。原`nextTask`如继续指向冻结/删除任务，应保留历史文本但在活动导航中明确覆盖，不能被恢复脚本或子代理继续自动领取。

using Terraria.ID;
using MKLP.Functions;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Steamworks;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using TShockAPI;

namespace MKLP
{
    public class Config
    {
        public CONFIG_HELPTEXT Guide { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_MAIN Main { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_PERMISSIONS Permissions { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_DISCORD Discord { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_BOSSES BossManager { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_DATABASE DataBaseMain { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_DATABASE_LINKING DataBaseDLink { get; set; } = new();
        public CONFIG_UNRELEASE_FEATURE Unrelease { get; set; } = new();

        static string path = Path.Combine(TShock.SavePath, "MKLP_Config.json");

        //static bool UsingXML = File.Exists(Path.Combine(TShock.SavePath, "MKLPConfig-USEXML.txt"));
        // canceled

        public static Config Read()
        {
            if (!File.Exists(TShock.SavePath))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(TShock.SavePath);
            }
            if (!File.Exists(path))
            {
                if (File.Exists(OldConfig.path))
                {
                    Config newconfig;

                    if (!Old_Config_Transfer(OldConfig.Read(), out newconfig))
                    {
                        throw new Exception("Unable to transfer old config file to new one");
                    }

                    File.WriteAllText(path, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(newconfig, Formatting.Indented));
                    return newconfig;
                } else
                {
                    File.WriteAllText(path, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(Default(), Formatting.Indented));
                    return Default();
                }
            }


            var args = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<Config>(File.ReadAllText(path));

            if (args == null) return Default();

            args.Guide = new(); //help text should not be modified!

            if (args.Main == null) args.Main = new();
            args.Main.FixNull();


            if (args.Discord == null) args.Discord = new();
            args.Discord.FixNull();

            if (args.Permissions == null) args.Permissions = new();
            args.Permissions.FixNull();

            if (args.BossManager == null) args.BossManager = new();
            args.BossManager.FixNull();

            if (args.DataBaseMain == null) args.DataBaseMain = new();
            args.DataBaseMain.FixNull();

            if (args.DataBaseDLink == null) args.DataBaseDLink = new();
            args.DataBaseDLink.FixNull();

            if (args.Unrelease == null) args.Unrelease = new();
            args.Unrelease.FixNull();

            File.WriteAllText(path, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(args, Formatting.Indented));
            return args;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// changes config file
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="config"></param>
        public void Changeall()
        {
            if (!File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.WriteAllText(path, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(Default(), Formatting.Indented));
            }
            else
            {
                File.WriteAllText(path, JsonConvert.SerializeObject(this, Formatting.Indented));
            }
        }

        private static Config Default()
        {
            return new Config()
            {
                Guide = new(),
                Main = new(),
                Permissions = new(),
                Discord = new(),
                BossManager = new(),
                DataBaseMain = new(),
                DataBaseDLink = new(),
                Unrelease = new(),
            };
        }

            #region [ Pirate Invasion ]

                    {
                        getillegalitems.Add(157, "Duke Fishron");
                    }
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #endregion

            foreach (int whitelist in MKLP.Config.Main.DisableNode.WhiteList_Survival_Code1)
            {
                if (getillegalitems.ContainsKey(whitelist))
                {
                    getillegalitems.Remove(whitelist);
                }
            }

            return getillegalitems;
        }

                /*

                foreach (int add in addin)
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(add))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(add, "Goblin Army");
                    }
                }
                */
            }
            #endregion

            #region [ Pirate Invasion ]
            if (!NPC.downedPirates) // Pirate Invasion
            {
                short[] addin = { 162, 281 };
                foreach (short add in addin)
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(add))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(add, "Pirate Invasion");
                    }
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #region [ Frost Legion ]
            if (!NPC.downedFrost)
            {
                /*
                int[] addin = { };
                foreach (int add in addin)
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(add))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(add, "Frost Legion");
                    }
                }
                */
            }
            #endregion

            #region [ Solar Pillar ]
            if (!NPC.downedTowerSolar)
            {
                if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(846))
                {
                    getillegalprojectile.Add(846, "Solar Pillar");
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #endregion

            #region ( weapon switch )
            if (Main.remixWorld || Main.zenithWorld)
            {
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(93))
                {
                    getillegalprojectile.Remove(93);
                }
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(271))
                {
                    getillegalprojectile.Remove(271);
                }
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(120))
                {
                    getillegalprojectile.Remove(120);
                }
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(410))
                {
                    if (allowdungeonrush || (NPC.downedBoss3 || currentbossdefeated == BossDType.Skeletron))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Remove(410);
                    }

                }
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(114))
                {
                    if (allowdungeonrush || (NPC.downedBoss3 || currentbossdefeated == BossDType.Skeletron))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Remove(114);
                    }

                }
                if (!Main.hardMode && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.WallOfFlesh)
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(954))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(954, "HardMode | Wall of Flesh");
                    }
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(979))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(979, "HardMode | Wall of Flesh");
                    }
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(273))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(273, "HardMode | Wall of Flesh");
                    }
                }
                if (!NPC.downedMechBossAny && (currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheDestroyer && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheTwins && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.SkeletronPrime))
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(15))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(15, "Mechanical Bosses");
                    }
                }
                if (!NPC.downedFishron && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.DukeFishron)
                {
                    if (!getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(22))
                    {
                        getillegalprojectile.Add(22, "Duke Fishron");
                    }
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #endregion

            foreach (short whitelist in MKLP.Config.Main.DisableNode.WhiteList_Survival_Code2)
            {
                if (getillegalprojectile.ContainsKey(whitelist))
                {
                    getillegalprojectile.Remove(whitelist);
                }
            }

            return getillegalprojectile;
        }

        public struct MKLP_Tile
        {
            public ushort ID;
            public short SubID;
            bool AllSubID;
            public MKLP_Tile(ushort ID, short SubID, bool AllSubID = false)
            {
                this.ID = ID;
                this.SubID = SubID;
                if (AllSubID == true) this.SubID = 0;
                this.AllSubID = AllSubID;
            }

            public static bool[] ObjectIDs = new bool[692];
        }

        public static Dictionary<MKLP_Tile, string> GetIllegalTile(BossDType currentbossdefeated = BossDType.NA)
        {
            #region [ get Illegal Tile ]

            Dictionary<MKLP_Tile, string> getillegaltile = new();

            //bool bothevilworld = (Main.drunkWorld || Main.remixWorld || Main.zenithWorld);

            bool allowdungeonrush = (bool)MKLP.Config.Main.Progression.AllowDungeonRush;
            bool allowtemplerush = (bool)MKLP.Config.Main.Progression.AllowTempleRush;

            bool allowmusicbox = (bool)MKLP.Config.Main.Progression.AllowMusicBox;

            //current: 735

            #region | unobtainable |

            MKLP_Tile[] unobtainableids = { new(5, 0, true), new(10, 11), new(21, 52), new(21, 53), new(26, 0, true), new(28, 0, true),
                new(31, 0, true), new(32, 0, true), new(441, 52), new(441, 53), new(441, 2), new(441, 4), new(441, 5), new(441, 6),
                new(441, 23), new(441, 24), new(441, 25), new(441, 26), new(441, 27), new(441, 36), new(441, 38), new(441, 40),
                new(468, 13) };

            foreach (MKLP_Tile add in unobtainableids)
            {
                if (!getillegaltile.ContainsKey(add))
                {
                    getillegaltile.Add(add, "Illegal");
                }
            }

            /*
            MKLP_Tile[] cannotplace = { new(21, 3), new(21, 23), new(21, 24), new(21, 25), new(21, 26), new(21, 27), new(21, 36),
                new(21, 38), new(21, 40), new(80, 0, true), new(165, 0, true), new(185, 0, true), new(186, 0, true), new(187, 0, true),
                new(227, 6), new(227, 12), new(227, 13), new(227, 14), new(231, 0), new(233, 0, true), new(236, 0, true),
                new(238, 0, true), new(323, 0), new(485, 0), new(518, 0), new(519, 0), new(529, 0), new(530, 0), new(549, 0),
                new(624, 0), new(668, 0) };

            foreach (MKLP_Tile add in cannotplace)
            {
                if (!getillegaltile.ContainsKey(add))
                {
                    getillegaltile.Add(add, "Unplacable");
                }
            }
            */
            #endregion

            #region ( Banners )

            bool allowbanners = (bool)MKLP.Config.Main.Progression.AllowBanners;

            if (!allowbanners)
            {
                if (!NPC.downedBoss2 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.EvilBoss)
                {
                    MKLP_Tile[] addin = { new(91, 76) };
                    foreach (MKLP_Tile add in addin)
                    {
                        getillegaltile.Add(add, "Evil Boss");
                    }
                }

                if (!NPC.downedBoss3 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.Skeletron)
                {
                    if (!Main.drunkWorld && !Main.remixWorld)
                    {
                        MKLP_Tile[] addin = { new(91, 89), new(91, 123), new(91, 128), new(91, 268) };
                        foreach (MKLP_Tile add in addin)
                        {
                            getillegaltile.Add(add, "Skeletron");
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!Main.hardMode && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.WallOfFlesh)
                {
                    MKLP_Tile[] addin = { new(91, 22), new(91, 23), new(91, 26), new(91, 27), new(91, 30), new(91, 32),
                       new(91, 33), new(91, 36), new(91, 37), new(91, 38), new(91, 43), new(91, 44), new(91, 47),
                        new(91, 49), new(91, 52), new(91, 57), new(91, 58), new(91, 67), new(91, 69), new(91, 70),
                        new(91, 73), new(91, 78), new(91, 80), new(91, 83), new(91, 84), new(91, 95), new(91, 96),
                        new(91, 102), new(91, 103), new(91, 104), new(91, 107), new(91, 109), new(91, 110), new(91, 117),
                        new(91, 120), new(91, 121), new(91, 122), new(91, 135), new(91, 137), new(91, 144), new(91, 146),
                        new(91, 148), new(91, 149), new(91, 150), new(91, 174), new(91, 178), new(91, 181), new(91, 185),
                        new(91, 188), new(91, 207), new(91, 229), new(91, 232), new(91, 233), new(91, 234), new(91, 235),
                        new(91, 236), new(91, 258), new(91, 259), new(91, 260), new(91, 261), new(91, 265), new(91, 266),
                        new(91, 267), new(91, 269), new(91, 272), new(91, 273), new(91, 274), new(91, 275), new(91, 276),
                        new(91, 281), new(91, 282), new(91, 283), new(91, 284), new(91, 291), new(91, 292), new(91, 293),
                        new(91, 294), new(91, 297), new(91, 298), new(91, 305), new(91, 306), new(91, 307), new(91, 308),
                        new(91, 309) };
                    foreach (MKLP_Tile add in addin)
                    {
                        getillegaltile.Add(add, "HardMode | Wall of Flesh");
                    }
                }

                if ((!NPC.downedMechBoss1 && !NPC.downedMechBoss2 && !NPC.downedMechBoss3) &&
                    (currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheDestroyer && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheTwins && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.SkeletronPrime)) // mech
                {
                    MKLP_Tile[] addin = { new(91, 55), new(91, 77), new(91, 94), new(91, 99), new(91, 132), new(91, 155),
                        new(91, 211), new(91, 212), new(91, 216), new(91, 263) };
                    foreach (MKLP_Tile add in addin)
                    {
                        getillegaltile.Add(add, "Mechanical Boss");
                    }
                }

                if ((!NPC.downedMechBoss1 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheDestroyer) ||
                    (!NPC.downedMechBoss2 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.TheTwins) ||
                    (!NPC.downedMechBoss3 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.SkeletronPrime)) // post mech
                {
                    MKLP_Tile[] addin = { new(91, 86) };
                    foreach (MKLP_Tile add in addin)
                    {
                        getillegaltile.Add(add, "Post Mechanical Boss");

        public static Dictionary<ushort, string> GetIllegalWall(BossDType currentbossdefeated = BossDType.NA)
        {
            #region [ get Illegal Walls ]
            Dictionary<ushort, string> getillegalwalls = new();

            //bool bothevilworld = (Main.drunkWorld || Main.remixWorld || Main.zenithWorld);

            #region | unobtainable |

            ushort[] unobtainableids = { 2, 3, 13, 14, 15, 28, 61, 63, 64, 65, 69, 70, 71, 79, 80, 81, 83,
                86, 170, 171, 178, 180, 185, 244 };

            foreach (ushort add in unobtainableids)
            {
                getillegalwalls.Add(add, "Unobtainable");
            }

            for (ushort i = 48; i <= 59; i++)
            {
                if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(i))
                {
                    getillegalwalls.Add(i, "Unobtainable");
                }
            }

            for (ushort i = 188; i <= 215; i++)
            {
                if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(i))
                {
                    getillegalwalls.Add(i, "Unobtainable");
                }
            }

            for (ushort i = 217; i <= 222; i++)
            {
                if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(i))
                {
                    getillegalwalls.Add(i, "Unobtainable");
                }
            }

            #endregion

            //2223 

            //100

            #region ( Boss )

            #region [ king Slime ]
            if (!NPC.downedSlimeKing && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.KingSlime) //king slime
            {
                ushort[] addin = { 76 };
                foreach (ushort add in addin)
                {
                    if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(add))
                    {
                        getillegalwalls.Add(add, "King Slime");
                    }
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #region [ Evil Boss ]
            if (!NPC.downedBoss2 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.EvilBoss)
            {
                ushort[] addin = { 182 };
                foreach (ushort add in addin)
                {
                    if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(add))
                    {
                        getillegalwalls.Add(add, "Evil Boss");
                    }
                }

                if (!Main.hardMode && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.WallOfFlesh)
                {
                    ushort[] hellstoneid = { 116, 117, 119, 120, 121, 122, 174, 175,
                        217, 219, 221, 231, 232, 233, 273, 2365, 4533, 4534, 4535, 4536, 4821 };

                    foreach (ushort add in hellstoneid) // hellstone are breakable from bombs on hm
                    {
                        if (!getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(add))
                        {
                            getillegalwalls.Add(add, "Evil Boss");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            #endregion

            #region [ Skeletron ]
            if (!NPC.downedBoss3 && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.Skeletron)
            {

                int[] addin = { 346, 509, 510, 513, 541, 849, 850, 851, 852, 853, 1263, 1273,
                    1313, 1363, 2295, 2296, 2739, 2799, 3085, 3205, 3220, 3221, 3245, 3282,
                    3323, 3619, 3620, 3625, 3629, 3707, 3725, 4264, 4484, 4485, 4703, 4801,
                    4818, 4927, 4993 };

            #region [ Golem ]

            if (!NPC.downedGolemBoss && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.Golem)
            {

                foreach (ushort add in addin)

            #region [ Lunatic Cultist ]

            if (!NPC.downedAncientCultist && currentbossdefeated != BossDType.LunaticCultist)

                {

                    {
                        getillegalwalls.Add(add, "Moon Lord");
                    }
                }
            }

            #endregion

            #endregion


            #endregion

            foreach (ushort whitelist in MKLP.Config.Main.DisableNode.WhiteList_Survival_Code4)
            {
                if (getillegalwalls.ContainsKey(whitelist))
                {
                    getillegalwalls.Remove(whitelist);
                }
            }

            return getillegalwalls;
        }

        public static bool ItemSuspicion(Item item)
        {
            int maxvalue = 10;

            if (Main.hardMode) maxvalue = 100;

            if ((item.value * item.stack) / 5000000 >= maxvalue && item.type != 74) return true;

            if (MKLP.IllegalItemProgression.ContainsKey(item.type)) return true;

            return false;
        }

        {

        }

`src/AntiCheat.Core/AntiCheatEngine.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;

namespace AntiCheat.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Pure server-side coordinator. Observe is synchronous and performs no I/O: revoke precedes publication
/// of an intent. A host-owned, bounded pump performs persistence on its audited execution context.
/// </summary>
public sealed class AntiCheatEngine
{
    private sealed class Session(SessionKey key, DateTimeOffset connectedUtc, long timestamp)
    {
        public SessionKey Key { get; } = key;
        public DateTimeOffset ConnectedUtc { get; } = connectedUtc;
        public long LastActivity { get; set; } = timestamp;
        public long? AccountId { get; set; }
        public bool Revoked { get; set; }
        public SessionSnapshot Snapshot() => new(Key, AccountId, Revoked, ConnectedUtc);
    }

    private sealed class Enforcement(BanIntent intent, long timestamp, bool journaled = false)
    {
        public BanIntent Intent { get; } = intent;
        public long EnqueuedAt { get; } = timestamp;
        public bool Journaled { get; set; } = journaled;
        public bool BanApplied { get; set; }
        public bool Applied { get; set; }
    }

    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim worker = new(1, 1);
    private readonly TimeProvider clock;
    private readonly EngineOptions options;
    private readonly RulePolicy policy;
    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, BusinessRulePolicy> businessPolicies;
    private readonly IEnforcementJournal journal;
    private readonly IAccountBanStore bans;
    private readonly Session?[] sessions;
    private readonly long[] generations;
    // Permanent account fences are security state, not an expiring suspicion cache. At capacity the
    // engine enters maintenance; it never evicts a pending sanction or forgets a revoked identity.
    private readonly Dictionary<long, Enforcement> sanctions = [];
    private readonly Guid serverRun = Guid.NewGuid();
    private long worldEpoch = 1;
    private bool recovered;
    private bool capacityReached;
    private bool recoveryFault;
    private bool persistenceFault;
    private long? oldestPendingAt;
    private bool stopping;
    private bool runGuardStarted;
    private string? runGuardFault;

    public AntiCheatEngine(TimeProvider clock, EngineOptions options, RulePolicy policy,
        IEnforcementJournal journal, IAccountBanStore bans, IReadOnlyList<BusinessRulePolicy>? businessRules = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(clock);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(policy);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(journal);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(bans);
        if (options.MaxSessions is < 1 or > 256 || options.MaxSanctions is < 1 or > 1_000_000 ||
            options.SessionIdleTtl <= TimeSpan.Zero || options.PersistenceDeadline <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(options));
        this.clock = clock;
        this.options = options;
        this.policy = policy;
        if (businessRules is { Count: > 128 } || businessRules?.Any(x => x is null ||
            !ValidText(x.RuleId, 128) || !ValidText(x.Version, 64) || !ValidText(x.ContextVersion, 128) ||
            !ValidText(x.RuntimeFingerprint, 1024) || !ValidText(x.AuditReference, 1024)) == true)
            throw new ArgumentException("Invalid or oversized business rule registry.", nameof(businessRules));
        businessPolicies = (businessRules ?? []).ToDictionary(x => x.RuleId, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        this.journal = journal;
        this.bans = bans;
        sessions = new Session[options.MaxSessions];
        generations = new long[options.MaxSessions];
    }

    public bool IsMaintenanceMode { get { lock (gate) return MaintenanceUnsafe(); } }
    public string? MaintenanceReason
    {
        get
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                _ = MaintenanceUnsafe();
                if (stopping) return "shutdown-in-progress";
                if (runGuardFault is not null) return runGuardFault;
                if (!recovered || recoveryFault) return "journal-recovery-required";
                if (capacityReached) return "permanent-account-fence-capacity";
                if (persistenceFault) return "sanction-persistence-unavailable";
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
    public int PendingCount { get { lock (gate) return sanctions.Values.Count(x => !x.Applied); } }
    public int SanctionCount { get { lock (gate) return sanctions.Count; } }

    public SessionKey? OpenSession(int slot)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if ((uint)slot >= sessions.Length || MaintenanceUnsafe()) return null;
            var key = new SessionKey(serverRun, worldEpoch, slot, checked(++generations[slot]));
            sessions[slot] = new Session(key, clock.GetUtcNow(), clock.GetTimestamp());
            return key;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Only after the server authenticates this account AND passes its durable ban checks.</summary>
    public AuthenticationResult Authenticate(SessionKey key, long serverAccountId)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (MaintenanceUnsafe()) return AuthenticationResult.Maintenance;
            var session = CurrentUnsafe(key);
            if (session is null) return AuthenticationResult.StaleSession;
            if (serverAccountId <= 0) return AuthenticationResult.InvalidAccount;
            if (sanctions.ContainsKey(serverAccountId))
            {
                session.Revoked = true;
                return AuthenticationResult.AccountBlocked;
            }
            if (session.AccountId is long bound && bound != serverAccountId)
            {
                session.Revoked = true;
                return AuthenticationResult.IdentityChangeRejected;
            }
            if (session.Revoked) return AuthenticationResult.AccountBlocked;
            session.AccountId = serverAccountId;
            session.LastActivity = clock.GetTimestamp();
            return AuthenticationResult.Authenticated;
        }
    }

    public void Disconnect(SessionKey key)
    {
        lock (gate)
            if ((uint)key.Slot < sessions.Length && sessions[key.Slot]?.Key == key)
                sessions[key.Slot] = null;
    }

    public void AdvanceWorld()
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            worldEpoch = checked(worldEpoch + 1);
            Array.Clear(sessions);
        }
    }

    public long CurrentWorldEpoch { get { lock (gate) return worldEpoch; } }

    public SessionSnapshot? GetSession(SessionKey key)
    {
        lock (gate) return CurrentUnsafe(key)?.Snapshot();
    }

    public bool CanWrite(SessionKey key)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            var session = CurrentUnsafe(key);
            return !MaintenanceUnsafe() && session is { Revoked: false };
        }
    }

    public bool Touch(SessionKey key)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            var session = CurrentUnsafe(key);
            if (MaintenanceUnsafe() || session is not { Revoked: false }) return false;
            session.LastActivity = clock.GetTimestamp();
            return true;
        }
    }

    public ActionDecision Observe(SelfSlotObservation observation)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(observation);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(observation.Context);
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (MaintenanceUnsafe()) return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.Fault, "maintenance");
            var session = CurrentUnsafe(observation.Session);
            if (session is null) return Block("stale-or-expired-session");
            if (session.Revoked)
            {
                var old = session.AccountId is long account && sanctions.TryGetValue(account, out var previous)
                    ? previous.Intent : null;
                return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.UnsafeInput, "session-revoked", old);
            }
            session.LastActivity = clock.GetTimestamp();

            var context = observation.Context;
            if (!context.ParseComplete) return Unknown("incomplete-parse");
            if (observation.ClaimedSlot is < 0 or > 255) return Block("invalid-slot-representation");
            if (observation.ClaimedSlot == session.Key.Slot || context.KnownLegalException)
                return new(ControlAction.Pass, Verdict.Pass, "self-slot-or-known-legal-exception");
            var proof = new ProofPreconditions(
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(policy.RuntimeFingerprint) &&
                    policy.RuntimeFingerprint != "unknown" && policy.RuntimeFingerprint == context.RuntimeFingerprint,
                QualifiedUnsafe(), context.ParseComplete, session.AccountId is > 0,
                context.ClientOrigin, context.AttributionComplete, context.ExceptionsExcluded,
                !policy.SelfOnlyPacketIds.IsDefault && policy.SelfOnlyPacketIds.Contains(observation.PacketId),
                ValidText(context.ContextVersion, 128) && policy.ContextVersion == context.ContextVersion);
            if (!proof.Complete) return Unknown("proof-preconditions-incomplete");
            // This predicate proves only the narrowly admitted self-only protocol rule. No Bouncer
            // decision, delay, NaN, item provenance, rarity or repeated suspicion contributes to it.
            var accountId = session.AccountId!.Value;
            foreach (var active in sessions)
                if (active?.AccountId == accountId) active.Revoked = true;
            if (sanctions.TryGetValue(accountId, out var existing))
                return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ProvenCheat, "account-already-sanctioned", existing.Intent);
            var incidentId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var now = clock.GetUtcNow();
            var evidence = new Evidence(incidentId, "A02.SelfSlot", "1.0.0", session.Key, accountId, now,
                context.RuntimeFingerprint, context.ContextVersion, policy.AuditReference, policy.Qualification,
                proof, observation.PacketId, session.Key.Slot, observation.ClaimedSlot);
            var intent = new BanIntent(incidentId, accountId, evidence, now);
            sanctions.Add(accountId, new Enforcement(intent, clock.GetTimestamp()));
            oldestPendingAt ??= clock.GetTimestamp();
            // Enter maintenance as soon as the bounded security state fills, before a further proven
            // incident could be observed without somewhere to retain its intent.
            capacityReached = sanctions.Count >= options.MaxSanctions;
            return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ProvenCheat, "first-complete-proof", intent);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Apply a registered business predicate without allowing it to choose identity or qualification.</summary>
    public ActionDecision ObserveBusiness(BusinessObservation observation)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(observation);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(observation.Result);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(observation.Context);
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (MaintenanceUnsafe()) return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.Fault, "maintenance");
            var session = CurrentUnsafe(observation.Session);
            if (session is null) return Block("stale-or-expired-session");
            if (session.Revoked)
            {
                var old = session.AccountId is long id && sanctions.TryGetValue(id, out var prior) ? prior.Intent : null;
                return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.UnsafeInput, "session-revoked", old);
            }
            session.LastActivity = clock.GetTimestamp();
            var result = observation.Result;
            var context = observation.Context;
            if (!businessPolicies.TryGetValue(result.RuleId, out var rule) || rule.Version != result.Version)
                return Unknown("business-rule-not-registered");
            var versionMatched = rule.RuntimeFingerprint != "unknown" && rule.RuntimeFingerprint == context.RuntimeFingerprint;
            if (!versionMatched || !context.ParseComplete || rule.ContextVersion != context.ContextVersion)
                return Unknown("business-input-version-or-parser-unverified");
            if (result.Facts is null || result.Facts.Count > 24 || result.Facts.Any(x =>
                !ValidText(x.Key, 64) || x.Value is null || x.Value.Length > 256))
                return Unknown("business-evidence-out-of-bounds");
            if (!ValidText(result.Reason, 256)) return Unknown("invalid-business-reason");
            if (result.Verdict == Verdict.Pass && result.Action == ControlAction.Pass)
                return new(ControlAction.Pass, Verdict.Pass, result.Reason);
            // Independent safety controls need a complete, versioned parse, never a cheating inference.
            if (result.Action == ControlAction.Block && result.Verdict is Verdict.UnsafeInput or Verdict.ResourceAbuse)
                return new(ControlAction.Block, result.Verdict, result.Reason);
            if (result.Verdict != Verdict.ProvenCheat || !result.PredicateSatisfied || context.KnownLegalException)
                return Unknown(result.Reason);
            var proof = new ProofPreconditions(versionMatched, QualificationMatches(rule.Qualification),
                context.ParseComplete, session.AccountId is > 0, context.ClientOrigin,
                context.AttributionComplete, context.ExceptionsExcluded, false, true, result.PrerequisitesComplete);
            if (!proof.Complete) return Unknown("business-proof-preconditions-incomplete");
            // String facts have stable value equality across journal serialization/recovery.
            var facts = JsonSerializer.Serialize(result.Facts.OrderBy(x => x.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                .ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Value));
            if (facts.Length > 8192) return Unknown("business-evidence-out-of-bounds");
            var accountId = session.AccountId!.Value;
            foreach (var active in sessions)
                if (active?.AccountId == accountId) active.Revoked = true;
            if (sanctions.TryGetValue(accountId, out var existing))
                return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ProvenCheat, "account-already-sanctioned", existing.Intent);
            var incidentId = Guid.NewGuid();
            var now = clock.GetUtcNow();
            var evidence = new Evidence(incidentId, rule.RuleId, rule.Version, session.Key, accountId, now,
                context.RuntimeFingerprint, context.ContextVersion, rule.AuditReference, rule.Qualification,
                proof, observation.PacketId, session.Key.Slot, session.Key.Slot, facts);
            var intent = new BanIntent(incidentId, accountId, evidence, now);
            sanctions.Add(accountId, new Enforcement(intent, clock.GetTimestamp()));
            oldestPendingAt ??= clock.GetTimestamp();
            capacityReached = sanctions.Count >= options.MaxSanctions;
            return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ProvenCheat, "first-complete-business-proof", intent);
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask<bool> RecoverAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (!await worker.WaitAsync(0, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false)) return false;
        try
        {
            IReadOnlyList<BanIntent> pending;
            try { pending = await journal.ReadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false); }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
            catch
            {
                lock (gate) recoveryFault = true;
                return false;
            }
            lock (gate)
            {
                // Validate the complete bounded recovery set before importing anything.
                if (pending.Count > options.MaxSanctions || pending.Any(x => !ValidIntent(x) || !RecoveryScopeMatches(x)) ||
                    pending.GroupBy(x => x.AccountId).Any(x => x.Distinct().Count() > 1) ||
                    pending.GroupBy(x => x.IncidentId).Any(x => x.Select(y => y.AccountId).Distinct().Count() > 1) ||
                    sanctions.Keys.Union(pending.Select(x => x.AccountId)).Count() > options.MaxSanctions)
                {
                    recoveryFault = true;
                    return false;
                }
                foreach (var intent in pending)
                {
                    if (sanctions.TryGetValue(intent.AccountId, out var prior))
                    {
                        if (prior.Intent != intent) { recoveryFault = true; return false; }
                        prior.Journaled = true;
                    }
                    else sanctions.Add(intent.AccountId, new Enforcement(intent, clock.GetTimestamp(), true));
                    foreach (var active in sessions)
                        if (active?.AccountId == intent.AccountId) active.Revoked = true;
                }
                recovered = false; // Admissions stay closed until the durable run marker is armed.
                recoveryFault = false;
                capacityReached = sanctions.Count >= options.MaxSanctions;
                oldestPendingAt = sanctions.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => !x.Applied)?.EnqueuedAt;
            }
            if (journal is IRunSafetyGuard guard)
            {
                RunSafetyStatus status;
                try
                {
                    status = await guard.BeginRunAsync(new(serverRun, options.Scope, AnyQualifiedRuleUnsafe()), cancellationToken)
                        .ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
                catch
                {
                    lock (gate) { runGuardFault = "run-safety-marker-unavailable"; recoveryFault = true; }
                    return false;
                }
                lock (gate)
                {
                    if (status != RunSafetyStatus.Ready)
                    {
                        runGuardFault = status == RunSafetyStatus.PreviousEnforcementRunUnclean
                            ? "previous-enforcement-run-unclean" : "legacy-journal-review-required";
                        recoveryFault = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                    runGuardStarted = true;
                    runGuardFault = null;
                }
            }
            else if (AnyQualifiedRuleUnsafe())
            {
                lock (gate) { runGuardFault = "durable-run-safety-guard-required"; recoveryFault = true; }
                return false;
            }
            lock (gate) recovered = true;
            return true;
        }
        finally { worker.Release(); }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stop admissions/proofs first. Mark clean only when every known intent has durable structured evidence.
    /// A persisted journal may still await the account DB: its pending entries replay on the next run.
    /// A busy pump returns false; the host may retry after that single operation completes.
    /// </summary>
    public async ValueTask<bool> CompleteShutdownAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        lock (gate) stopping = true;
        if (!await worker.WaitAsync(0, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false)) return false;
        try
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                if (!recovered || recoveryFault || sanctions.Values.Any(x => !x.Journaled)) return false;
            }
            if (journal is IRunSafetyGuard guard)
            {
                if (!runGuardStarted) return false;
                try { await guard.CompleteRunAsync(serverRun, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false); }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
                catch { return false; }
            }
            else if (AnyQualifiedRuleUnsafe()) return false;
            return true;
        }
        finally { worker.Release(); }
    }

    public async ValueTask<PumpResult> PumpAsync(int maxItems = 16, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (maxItems is < 1 or > 1024) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxItems));
        if (!await worker.WaitAsync(0, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
            return new(0, 0, 0, IsMaintenanceMode);
        try
        {
            Enforcement[] batch;
            lock (gate)
            {
                if (!recovered || recoveryFault) return new(0, 0, 0, true);
                batch = sanctions.Values.Where(x => !x.Applied).Take(maxItems).ToArray();
            }
            var applied = 0;
            var failed = 0;
            foreach (var item in batch)
            {
                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var journalOk = item.Journaled;
                var banOk = item.BanApplied;
                if (!journalOk)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await journal.AppendAsync(item.Intent, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        lock (gate) item.Journaled = true;
                        journalOk = true;
                    }
                    catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
                    catch { /* Primary durable store is an independent fallback. */ }
                }
                try
                {
                    if (!banOk)
                    {
                        await bans.EnsurePermanentlyBannedAsync(item.Intent, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        lock (gate) item.BanApplied = true;
                        banOk = true;
                    }
                    if (journalOk)
                    {
                        await journal.MarkAppliedAsync(item.Intent.IncidentId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        lock (gate) item.Applied = true;
                        applied++;
                    }
                    else failed++; // Preserve the evidence intent and retry the journal even if the DB succeeded.
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { throw; }
                catch { failed++; }
                lock (gate)
                {
                    if (!journalOk && !banOk) persistenceFault = true;
                    // A durable journal alone preserves recovery. A slow/unavailable account DB never
                    // re-enables this account; retries contain exactly the same immutable intent.
                    if (!item.Applied && Expired(item.EnqueuedAt, options.PersistenceDeadline))
                        persistenceFault = true;
                }
            }
            lock (gate)
            {
                oldestPendingAt = sanctions.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => !x.Applied)?.EnqueuedAt;
                if (sanctions.Values.All(x => x.Applied ||
                    ((x.Journaled || x.BanApplied) && !Expired(x.EnqueuedAt, options.PersistenceDeadline)))) persistenceFault = false;
                return new(batch.Length, applied, failed, MaintenanceUnsafe());
            }
        }
        finally { worker.Release(); }
    }

    private bool QualifiedUnsafe() => ValidText(policy.AuditReference, 1024) && ValidText(policy.RuntimeFingerprint, 1024) &&
        QualificationMatches(policy.Qualification);

    private bool QualificationMatches(RuleQualification qualification) =>
        options.Scope == ExecutionScope.TestLab && qualification == RuleQualification.TestLab ||
        options.Scope == ExecutionScope.Production && qualification == RuleQualification.ProductionQualified;

    private bool AnyQualifiedRuleUnsafe() => QualifiedUnsafe() || businessPolicies.Values.Any(x => QualificationMatches(x.Qualification));

    private bool MaintenanceUnsafe()
    {
        // O(1) deadline check also works while an I/O provider is stalled inside the single pump.
        if (oldestPendingAt is long since && Expired(since, options.PersistenceDeadline)) persistenceFault = true;
        return stopping || !recovered || recoveryFault || runGuardFault is not null || capacityReached || persistenceFault;
    }
    private bool Expired(long since, TimeSpan ttl)
    {
        var elapsed = clock.GetElapsedTime(since, clock.GetTimestamp());
        return elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero || elapsed >= ttl;
    }
    private Session? CurrentUnsafe(SessionKey key)
    {
        if ((uint)key.Slot >= sessions.Length) return null;
        var session = sessions[key.Slot];
        if (session?.Key != key) return null;
        if (!Expired(session.LastActivity, options.SessionIdleTtl)) return session;
        sessions[key.Slot] = null;
        return null;
    }
    private static bool ValidIntent(BanIntent x) => x is not null && x.IncidentId != Guid.Empty && x.AccountId > 0 &&
        x.Evidence is { Preconditions.Complete: true } && x.Evidence.AccountId == x.AccountId &&
        x.Evidence.EventId == x.IncidentId && ValidRecordedPredicate(x.Evidence) &&
        x.Evidence.Session.ServerRunId != Guid.Empty && x.Evidence.Session.WorldEpoch > 0 &&
        x.Evidence.Session.Generation > 0 && x.Evidence.Session.Slot == x.Evidence.ServerSlot &&
        x.Evidence.ServerSlot is >= 0 and < 256 && x.Evidence.ClientClaimedSlot is >= 0 and < 256 &&
        ValidText(x.Evidence.RuntimeFingerprint, 1024) && ValidText(x.Evidence.ContextVersion, 128) &&
        ValidText(x.Evidence.AuditReference, 1024);
    private static bool ValidRecordedPredicate(Evidence evidence) => evidence.PredicateFactsJson is null
        ? evidence.RuleId == "A02.SelfSlot" && evidence.RuleVersion == "1.0.0" &&
            evidence.ClientClaimedSlot != evidence.ServerSlot && evidence.Preconditions.RuleContextComplete is null
        : ValidText(evidence.RuleId, 128) && ValidText(evidence.RuleVersion, 64) &&
            evidence.Preconditions.RuleContextComplete == true && ValidFacts(evidence.PredicateFactsJson);

    private static bool ValidFacts(string json)
    {
        if (json.Length > 8192) return false;
        try
        {
            var values = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(json);
            return values is { Count: <= 24 } && values.All(x => ValidText(x.Key, 64) && x.Value is { Length: <= 256 });
        }
        catch (JsonException) { return false; }
    }
    private bool RecoveryScopeMatches(BanIntent intent) => options.Scope == ExecutionScope.TestLab
        ? intent.Evidence.Qualification == RuleQualification.TestLab
        : intent.Evidence.Qualification == RuleQualification.ProductionQualified;
    private static bool ValidText(string? value, int limit) => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) && value.Length <= limit;
    private static ActionDecision Unknown(string reason) => new(ControlAction.Unknown, Verdict.Unknown, reason);
    private static ActionDecision Block(string reason) => new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.UnsafeInput, reason);
}

`src/AntiCheat.Core/BoundedRateLimiter.cs`:

namespace AntiCheat.Core;

public sealed record RateLimitOptions(int MaxKeys, double Burst, double TokensPerSecond, TimeSpan IdleTtl);
public sealed record RateLimitDecision(ControlAction Behavior, Verdict Verdict, string Reason, double RemainingTokens);

/// <summary>Per-key cost budgets. Key admission and expired-entry work are bounded; rate decisions never ban accounts.</summary>
public sealed class BoundedRateLimiter
{
    private sealed class Bucket(string key, double tokens, long now)
    {
        public string Key { get; } = key;
        public double Tokens { get; set; } = tokens;
        public long UpdatedAt { get; set; } = now;
        public long LastSeen { get; set; } = now;
    }
    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly TimeProvider clock;
    private readonly RateLimitOptions options;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> indices = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Bucket?[] buckets;
    private readonly Queue<int> free;
    private int cursor;

    public BoundedRateLimiter(TimeProvider clock, RateLimitOptions options)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(clock);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(options);
        if (options.MaxKeys is < 1 or > 1_000_000 || !double.IsFinite(options.Burst) || options.Burst <= 0 ||
            !double.IsFinite(options.TokensPerSecond) || options.TokensPerSecond <= 0 || options.IdleTtl <= TimeSpan.Zero)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(options));
        this.clock = clock;
        this.options = options;
        buckets = new Bucket[options.MaxKeys];
        free = new Queue<int>(Enumerable.Range(0, options.MaxKeys));
    }
    public int Count { get { lock (gate) return indices.Count; } }

    /// <summary>Release a completed session's exact generation key. Do not use this to reset source/global budgets.</summary>
    public bool Forget(string key)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (!indices.Remove(key, out var index)) return false;
            buckets[index] = null;
            free.Enqueue(index);
            return true;
        }
    }

    /// <param name="key">A bounded server-owned connection/account/socket-source key, never a player command.</param>
    public RateLimitDecision TryConsume(string key, double cost = 1)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || key.Length > 128 || !double.IsFinite(cost) || cost <= 0)
            return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.UnsafeInput, "invalid-budget-input", 0);
        lock (gate)
        {
            var now = clock.GetTimestamp();
            Purge(now);
            Bucket bucket;
            if (indices.TryGetValue(key, out var index))
            {
                bucket = buckets[index]!;
                var elapsed = clock.GetElapsedTime(bucket.UpdatedAt, now);
                if (elapsed < TimeSpan.Zero)
                    return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ResourceAbuse, "monotonic-clock-invalid", bucket.Tokens);
                bucket.Tokens = Math.Min(options.Burst, bucket.Tokens + elapsed.TotalSeconds * options.TokensPerSecond);
                bucket.UpdatedAt = now;
                bucket.LastSeen = now;
            }
            else
            {
                if (free.Count == 0)
                    return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ResourceAbuse, "budget-key-capacity", 0);
                index = free.Dequeue();
                bucket = new Bucket(key, options.Burst, now);
                buckets[index] = bucket;
                indices.Add(key, index);
            }
            if (cost > bucket.Tokens)
                return new(ControlAction.Block, Verdict.ResourceAbuse, "cost-budget-exhausted", bucket.Tokens);
            bucket.Tokens -= cost;
            return new(ControlAction.Pass, Verdict.Pass, "within-cost-budget", bucket.Tokens);
        }
    }

    private void Purge(long now)
    {
        // At most eight buckets per attempt, including capacity rejection. A temporarily uncollected
        // expired slot can reject admission; a new address cannot force an all-key scan on every packet.
        for (var checkedCount = 0; checkedCount < Math.Min(8, buckets.Length); checkedCount++)
        {
            var index = cursor;
            cursor = (cursor + 1) % buckets.Length;
            var bucket = buckets[index];
            if (bucket is null) continue;
            var elapsed = clock.GetElapsedTime(bucket.LastSeen, now);
            if (elapsed < options.IdleTtl) continue;
            indices.Remove(bucket.Key);
            buckets[index] = null;
            free.Enqueue(index);
        }
    }
}

public sealed record Evidence(Guid EventId, string RuleId, string RuleVersion, SessionKey Session,

    byte PacketId, int ServerSlot, int ClientClaimedSlot,

/// <summary>
/// Local bounded durable journal. ReadAsync returns pending records only. Append and MarkApplied must be
/// idempotent. Pending records may never be expired/evicted. Corruption/capacity failures must throw.
/// Once applied, the account store is authoritative for permanent bans, including after process restart.
/// </summary>
public interface IEnforcementJournal
{
    ValueTask<IReadOnlyList<BanIntent>> ReadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    ValueTask AppendAsync(BanIntent intent, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    ValueTask MarkAppliedAsync(Guid incidentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

/// <summary>
/// Idempotent permanent server-authenticated account ban. The adapter must perform the actual durable ban,
/// throw on failure and run on the audited execution context. Success must mean durable, not merely queued.
/// Normal login must consult this durable store before Authenticate, including after a restart.
/// </summary>
public interface IAccountBanStore
{
    ValueTask EnsurePermanentlyBannedAsync(BanIntent intent, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public enum RunSafetyStatus { Ready, PreviousEnforcementRunUnclean, LegacyStateNeedsReview }
public sealed record RunSafetyRequest(Guid ServerRunId, ExecutionScope Scope, bool CanProduceProofs);

/// <summary>
/// Arm a durable marker before enabling proof production. A previous armed run without a confirmed
/// clean shutdown may have lost a memory-only intent; an empty journal cannot establish safety.
/// Test doubles can model this interface, but only an actual durable implementation proves restart safety.
/// Required for any host enabling qualified TestLab or Production rules; omission puts Core in maintenance.
/// </summary>
public interface IRunSafetyGuard
{
    ValueTask<RunSafetyStatus> BeginRunAsync(RunSafetyRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    ValueTask CompleteRunAsync(Guid serverRunId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

```cs
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace AntiCheat.Core;

public enum FirewallRecommendation { RecordOnly, ProposeTemporaryBlock }
public enum NetworkAbuseReason { ConnectionBudget, HandshakeTimeout, WeightedPacketCost, BroadcastAmplification }
public sealed record NetworkWindow(DateTimeOffset StartUtc, DateTimeOffset EndUtc, long Connections, long Bytes, long Cost);
public sealed record FirewallDryRunEvent(Guid EventId, DateTimeOffset ObservedUtc, SessionKey? Session,
    long? AccountId, string SocketPeer, string? VerifiedClientAddress, string AddressProvenance,
    bool ProxyPeer, bool ExclusiveSourceVerified, NetworkWindow Window, NetworkAbuseReason Reason,
    string RuleVersion, int SuggestedTtlSeconds, string? EvidenceReference, FirewallRecommendation Recommendation,
    string? ProposedTarget, bool DryRun = true, bool Execute = false);

/// <summary>Stateless structured output only. Contains no IPC, process launch, firewall access or shell formatting.</summary>
public sealed class FirewallDryRun(TimeProvider clock)
{
    public FirewallDryRunEvent Create(IPAddress socketPeer, NetworkWindow window, NetworkAbuseReason reason,
        TimeSpan suggestedTtl, SessionKey? session = null, long? accountId = null, bool proxyPeer = false,
        bool exclusiveSourceVerified = false, IPAddress? verifiedClientAddress = null, string? evidenceReference = null)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(socketPeer);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(window);
        if (window.EndUtc < window.StartUtc || window.Connections < 0 || window.Bytes < 0 || window.Cost < 0 ||
            suggestedTtl <= TimeSpan.Zero || accountId is <= 0 || evidenceReference?.Length > 256 ||
            !Enum.IsDefined(reason)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(window));
        var peer = Normalize(socketPeer);
        // NAT/shared-address safety is the default. A proxy socket is never a target, even if an
        // upstream real-address claim exists; execution at an audited ingress is a future adapter.
        var eligible = exclusiveSourceVerified && !proxyPeer && IsUnicast(peer);
        return new(Guid.NewGuid(), clock.GetUtcNow(), session, accountId, peer.ToString(),
            verifiedClientAddress is null ? null : Normalize(verifiedClientAddress).ToString(),
            "server-socket-peer", proxyPeer, exclusiveSourceVerified, window, reason, "network-dry-run/1.0.0",
            (int)Math.Clamp(suggestedTtl.TotalSeconds, 1, 900), evidenceReference,
            eligible ? FirewallRecommendation.ProposeTemporaryBlock : FirewallRecommendation.RecordOnly,
            eligible ? peer.ToString() : null);
    }
    public static string Serialize(FirewallDryRunEvent value) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
    private static IPAddress Normalize(IPAddress address) => address.IsIPv4MappedToIPv6 ? address.MapToIPv4() : address;
    private static bool IsUnicast(IPAddress address)
    {
        if (IPAddress.IsLoopback(address) || address.Equals(IPAddress.Any) || address.Equals(IPAddress.IPv6Any) ||
            address.IsIPv6Multicast || address.IsIPv6LinkLocal || address.IsIPv6SiteLocal) return false;
        var bytes = address.GetAddressBytes();
        return address.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork ||
            bytes[0] is > 0 and < 224 && bytes[0] != 10 &&
            !(bytes[0] == 172 && bytes[1] is >= 16 and <= 31) &&
            !(bytes[0] == 192 && bytes[1] == 168) && !(bytes[0] == 169 && bytes[1] == 254);
    }
}
